# telnyx_notification_event_conditions (Data Source)

Lists the notification event conditions, the conditions a notification setting can watch for, such as a balance threshold.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_associated_record_type` (String) Filter by the associated record type One of `account`, `phone_number`.
- `filter_channel_type_id` (String) Filter by the id of a channel type One of `email`, `sms`, `voice`, `webhook`.
- `filter_notification_channel` (String) Filter by the id of a notification channel
- `filter_notification_event_condition_id` (String) Filter by the id of a notification channel
- `filter_notification_profile_id` (String) Filter by the id of a notification profile
- `filter_status` (String) The status of a notification setting One of `delete-pending`, `delete-received`, `delete-submitted`, `deleted`, `enable-pending`, `enable-received`, `enable-submtited`, `enabled`.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `notification_event_conditions` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--notification_event_conditions))
